_comment: Every value here was measured, not chosen. See ai/reports/onnx_verification.json for the sweeps these came from. Editing this file retunes the deployed app without a code change.
_tau: Shipped operating point from MODEL_CARD.md section 5. Selected on the Mild-recall curve, not on balanced accuracy: 0.50 buys +4.5 points of early-case recall for 1.8 points of specificity. Do not raise it without re-reading that section.
_unclear: Dead-band routed to 'unclear'. Measured on the 611-image locked test split: abstains on 2.9% of photos, and on the ones still decided lifts recall 0.9629 -> 0.9746 and specificity 0.8551 -> 0.8593. Ten positives fall in the band; they are told to consult a vet anyway, so the safety action is unchanged. Widening to [0.30,0.70) reaches specificity 0.8811 but abstains on 6.5%.
_blur: Variance of the Laplacian on the 224x224 model input. 120 is the 0.5th percentile of the locked test split (min 20, median 969), so it rejects only genuinely unusable photos. Field photographs will be blurrier than these web-sourced images, so expect this to fire more often once real data arrives -- retune it then, from the field distribution.
_clipped: Fraction of pixels crushed to black (luma <= 4) or blown to white (luma >= 251). 0.35 flags 1.8% of test images on the bright side and 0.2% on the dark side. Deliberately permissive: a marginal photo is still worth collecting, it just should not get a confident verdict.
